30503.name: PITAKA Iphone 17 Pro Edge Case (PTK Leaping – Gold Green)

bullets.title: The Inspiration of a Thread
bullets.text: PITAKA's story begins with a thread of aramid fiber, a line that symbolizes our ongoing spirit of self-reflection and reinvention, reminding us to sweep away distractions and embrace purity. Inspired by this thread, we reimagined PITAKA's logo, turning it's initials into an artistic monogram design. It's our tribute to those bold enough to erase impurities and refine themselves.

bullets.title: Text Weaving to New Heights
bullets.text: Through the intricate interlacing of lightweight yet durable aramid fibers, the woven text on the case offers a unique and classic aesthetic while revealing refined textures that provide a delightful tactile experience.

bullets.title: PitaTap™
bullets.text: A case under 1 mm thick shields the Camera Control Button with aramid fiber, while a hidden capacitive layer lets you tap and slide effortlessly. Seamlessly integrated, it preserves the aramid texture for precise, responsive control.

bullets.title: Paper Thin & Feather Light
bullets.text: Offers a sleek, barely-there profile that preserves your phone's original feel. Ideal for minimalists seeking elegant protection without added weight.

bullets.title: A Leap in Charging Speed
bullets.text: Ideal for rapidly powering up iPhone 15 / 15 Pro, the high-powered 30W USB-C port offers a charging speed that's 3 times faster than standard 5W chargers.

bullets.title: Miniature Size, Maximum Power
bullets.text: With ultra-compact dimensions, this car charger is designed to fit in the smallest of spaces while providing exceptional charging capability.

bullets.title: Dual-Device Charging Made Easy
bullets.text: Power two phones simultaneously via the USB-C and USB-A ports, providing a practical solution for multiple device owners.

bullets.title: Charging Safety You Can Trust
bullets.text: Includes overvoltage, undervoltage, overcurrent, and over-temperature protection, plus intelligent power allocation for efficient and reliable charging.

bullets.title: What You Get
bullets.text: Anker Car Charger (30W, 2 Ports), welcome guide, 12-month warranty, and our friendly customer service.

30955.name: USB-C Hub 7-in-1 Multi-Port USB Adapter for Laptops

bullets.title: Sleek 7-in-1 USB-C Hub
bullets.text: Features an HDMI port, two USB-A 3.0 ports, and a USB-C data port, each providing 5Gbps transfer speeds. It also includes a USB-C PD input port for charging up to 100W and dual SD and TF card slots, all in a compact design.

bullets.title: Flawless 4K@60Hz Video with HDMI
bullets.text: Delivers exceptional clarity and smoothness with its 4K@60Hz HDMI port, making it ideal for high-definition presentations and entertainment. (Note: Only the HDMI port supports video projection; the USB-C port is for data transfer only.)

bullets.title: Double Up on Efficiency
bullets.text: The two USB-A 3.0 ports and a USB-C port support a fast 5Gbps data rate, significantly boosting your transfer speeds and improving productivity.

bullets.title: Fast and Reliable 85W Charging
bullets.text: Offers high-capacity, speedy charging for laptops up to 85W, so you spend less time tethered to an outlet and more time being productive.

bullets.title: What You Get
bullets.text: Anker USB-C Hub (7-in-1), welcome guide, 12-month warranty, and our friendly customer service.
